title: Reconnaissance and scanning
body:
Before an attack comes recon: which hosts exist, which services are open, which versions run. A scan asks each address and port. Service banners often reveal software and version.

Scanning is noisy and can be detected. Defenders: hide version details, close unused ports, remove retired hosts and alert on scans.

How to spot it: many connection attempts to different ports or addresses in a short time. Use scan and connect to see what an attacker sees, and note which banners give away software versions.
